name: H5N1 bird flu
value: 74 US cases since Apr 2024; no H2H
summary: US has reported 74 human H5 cases since April 2024, all animal-linked; no human-to-human spread found to 26 Nov
state: ECDC said on 9 Nov that the US has reported 74 human H5 cases from 13 states since April 2024, as of 5 Nov, including two dairy workers in Yakima County, Washington, one of whom died (ECDC). CNN reported on 2 Nov that US officials called the risk to the public low (CNN). Searches to 26 Nov found no human cluster or person-to-person spread, so cases remain sporadic and animal-linked and Normal holds.
for_you: Risk to the public is low. Avoid touching sick or dead birds and follow UKHSA and NHS advice.

why: H5N1 is the flu strain scientists most fear could become a pandemic; it has spread to mammals and dairy cattle.
